blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala’s bid to reach the semifinals of the Hong Kong Tennis Open will go through Antonia Ruzic of Croatia. Their first career meeting is scheduled for Friday as the last quarterfinal match on Center Court. Eala reached the quarterfinals for the second straight tournament after fending off Tereza Valentova, 6-4, 7-6 (7), in the Round of 16. READ: Alex Eala climbs to career-high World No. 17 in WTA rankings Ruzic, meanwhile, beat Wang Xinyu, 6-3, 4-6, 6-2, also on Thursday.
